title: 随机指标
original_formula:

D = SMA(K,M2,1)

name: calendar2023_2_1_2_u5f02_540c_79bb_5dee_4e56_79bb_7387
title: 异同离差乖离率
original_formula:
BIAS = (CLOSE-SMA(CLOSE,N1))/SMA(CLOSE,N1)
DIF = BIAS-BIAS\[N2\]
DBCD = SMA(DIF,N3,1)
SMA(X,N,M)为加权移动平均: Y = (X\*M+Y\*(N-M))/N
默认: N1 = 5、N2 = 16、N3 = 17

name: calendar2023_2_1_3_u4e56_79bb_7387
title: 乖离率

name: calendar2023_2_1_4_u52a8_6001_4e70_5356_6c14_6307_6807
title: 动态买卖气指标
original_formula:
DTM = IF(OPEN<OPEN\[1],0,MAX((HIGH-OPEN),(OPEN-OPEN\[1])))
DBM = IF(OPEN≥OPEN\[1],0,MAX((OPEN-LOW), OPEN-OPEN\[1])))
STM = SUM(DTM,N)
SBM = SUM(DBM,N)
ADTM = IF(STM>SBM,(STM-SBM)/STM,IF(STM=SBM,0, (STM-SBM)/SBM))
ADTMMMA = SMA(ADTM,M)
默认: N = 23、M = 8

name: calendar2023_2_1_5_u53d8_52a8_901f_7387
title: 变动速率
original_formula:

默认: N = 12、M = 6

name: calendar2023_2_1_6_u76f8_5bf9_5f3a_5f31_6307_6807
title: 相对强弱指标
original_formula:
UM = IF(CLOSE-CLOSE\[1]>0,CLOSE-CLOSE\[1],0)
DM = IF(CLOSE-CLOSE\[1]<0,CLOSE\[1]-CLOSE,0)
UA(N) = (UA\[1]\*(N-1)+UM)/N
DA(N) = (DA\[1]\*(N-1)+DM)/N
RSI = 100*(UA/(UA+DA))
UA初始值 = SMA(UM,N)
DA初始值 = SMA(DM,N)
默认: N = 14

name: calendar2023_2_1_7_u8d27_5e01_6d41_91cf_6307_6807
title: 货币流量指标
original_formula:
TP = (HIGH+LOW+CLOSE)/3
MF = TP\*VOL
PF(N) = SUM(IF(TP>TP\[1],MF,0),N)
NF(N) = SUM(IF(TP<=TP\[1],MF,0),N)
MR(N) = PF(N)/NF(N)
MFI = 100-(100/(1+MR))
默认: N = 20

name: calendar2023_2_1_8_u65b9_5411_6807_51c6_79bb_5dee_6307_6807
title: 方向标准离差指标
original_formula:
DMZ = IF(HIGH+LOW<=HIGH\[1]+LOW\[1],0,
DMF = IF(HIGH+LOW>HIGH\[1]+LOW\[1],0,
DIZ = SUM(DMZ,N)/(SUM(DMZ,N)+SUM(DMF,N))\*100
DIF = SUM(DMF,N)/(SUM(DMZ,N)+SUM(DMF,N))\*100
DDI = DIZ-DIF
若分母为 0，则令 DDI = 0
默认: N = 20

name: calendar2023_2_1_9_u5546_54c1_901a_9053_6307_6807
title: 商品通道指标

name: calendar2023_2_2_4_u968f_673a_52a8_91cf_6307_6807
title: 随机动量指标
original_formula:

SH1 = EMA(H,N1)
SH2 = EMA(SH1,N2)

name: calendar2023_2_3_3_u76f8_5bf9_6ce2_52a8_7387_6307_6807
title: 相对波动率指标
original_formula:
UM(PRICE,N1) = IF(PRICE>PRICE\[1],STD(PRICE,N1),0)
DM(PRICE,N1) = IF(PRICE<PRICE\[1],STD(PRICE,N1),0)
UA(N2) = (UA\[1]\*(N-1)+UM)/N2
DA(N2) = (DA\[1]\*(N-1)+DM)/N2

DA初始值 = SMA(DM,N)

title: 区域指数
original_formula:

W = IF(CLOSE>CLOSE\[1],TR/(CLOSE-CLOSE\[1]),TR)
SR(N1) = IF(MAX(W,N1)-MIN(W,N1)>0, (W-MIN(W,N1))/(MAX(W,N1)-MIN(W,N1))\*100, (W-MIN(W,N1))\*100)
RI(N1,N2) = EMA(SR(N1),N2)

name: calendar2023_2_4_1_u7d2f_8ba1_632f_52a8_5347_964d_6307_6807
title: 累计振动升降指标
original_formula:
A = ABS(HIGH-CLOSE\[1])
B = ABS(LOW-CLOSE\[1])
C = ABS(HIGH-LOW\[1])
D = ABS(CLOSE\[1]-OPEN\[1])
E = CLOSE-CLOSE\[1]
F = CLOSE-OPEN
G = CLOSE\[1]-OPEN\[1]

K = MAX(A,B)
R = IF(A>B AND A>C, A+0.5B+0.25D, IF(B>A AND B>C, B+0.5A+0.25D, C+0.25D))
SI = 16\*X/R\*K
